extension.summary: Films and TV with Trakt, TMDB and Premiumize
extension.description: SpongeTV brings Trakt syncing, TMDB metadata, Premiumize and your own provider packages together in one add-on. This is a stage 4 test build: browsing, metadata, Trakt, provider packages and playback through Premiumize.
extension.disclaimer: SpongeTV includes no content providers. You are responsible for the provider packages you install.
extension.news: 1.0.9: Two new lists under My TV shows: Still airing (shows you've watched that are still being made, those with a date for what's next first) and Ended or cancelled. Shows now have a line at the top of their plot, and their seasons', saying when the next season or episode airs, or that the show has ended or been cancelled (from TMDB; can be turned off in Settings). Each saved search has Remove from search history in its context menu. 1.0.8: Sources for older seasons of shows still running. SpongeTV told providers every season of such a show was still airing, so a4kScrapers searched only for the single episode and skipped season and complete-series packs; it now says so only of a season with episodes still to come, as Seren does. Providers are also given the other titles Trakt lists for a film or show, which they match release names against. 1.0.7: Marking a part-watched film or episode as watched from the Trakt menu now shows the tick. Its resume points (SpongeTV's own, and Trakt's) are removed as well, as they are when you watch to the end; before, the part-watched icon stayed and it still offered to resume.
